shared_elements: strongly schematic, reduced treatment of forms
paired rounded/oval elements read as eyes (the carved eyes in A, the arched paired motifs at the top of B)
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both are upright worked stone blocks with heavily schematised, reduced forms, and each contains paired rounded eye-like elements set high on the surface. Otherwise they differ fundamentally — A is a sculpture in the round of a single human head with deeply cut, coarse-textured facial features, while B is a flat, low-relief panel organised into registers of banded pattern, animals in profile and arm/hand motifs, with no comparable compositional scheme.
